rules.claim: Every execution-runbook Step heading derives exactly one task box without a per-cycle task list, both bold and plain checked forms enter the audit, every checked task box corresponds to progress and a real commit or an explicit declaration, and the first plain-task-box epoch requires a runbook-qualified progress entry so cross-runbook task-id collisions cannot select by file order.
rules.scope: The actual tools/checklist_audit.py run entry point over every Git-tracked execution runbook and its resolved progress record. Step headings derive the coverage population; a sole box inside its Step section wins, otherwise the heading-derived full id or label alias resolves the centralized cycle checklist, with the structurally named draft-runbook alias derived from its heading. Checked task boxes also include progress/declaration-backed extras such as activation and measured corrective tasks. The first runbook containing a derived plain task box establishes the forward-only qualifier epoch without a cycle list or minimum version. Earlier immutable runbooks retain their original contract. Planted fixtures cover an all-unbolded valid runbook, a checked id absent from progress, a derived Step with no box at all, and an unqualified task after the derived epoch.
